wish: someone should make an app that adds a Stranger Things upside down filter to photos
spec: Turns a photo into an Upside Down scene: drained cold blue, red glow, dark vignette, creeping vines, floating spores.\nChoose a photo (a sample shows first), pick mild, full or deep, optionally switch flicker on, then save the result as a JPEG.\nIt does not upload anything, detect faces, or flip the picture; everything stays on the device.
notes: Works offline on a canvas; the sample picture is generated in code. Spores and vines are procedural.
